question: give district wise ANC percentage-point increase between 2021 and 2023 only Gaya and Nalanda
gold_sql: WITH rates AS (SELECT district, year, 100.0 * anc4_completed / pregnancies_registered AS rate FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2021, 2023)) SELECT district, ROUND(MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN rate END), 1) AS change_pp FROM rates GROUP BY district ORDER BY district
sql_duckdb: WITH yearly_rates AS (SELECT district, year, CAST(anc4_completed AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0), 0) * 100 AS anc_percentage FROM anc_visits WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda') AND year IN (2021, 2023)), changes AS (SELECT r2023.district, r2023.anc_percentage - r2021.anc_percentage AS percentage_point_increase FROM yearly_rates AS r2021 JOIN yearly_rates AS r2023 ON r2021.district = r2023.district WHERE r2021.year = 2021 AND r2023.year = 2023) SELECT * FROM changes

CURRENT QUESTION:
give district wise ANC percentage-point increase between 2021 and 2023 only Gaya and Nalanda
attempts.response:
```sql
WITH yearly_rates AS (
  SELECT
    district,
    year,
    CAST(anc4_completed AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(pregnancies_registered, 0) * 100 AS anc_percentage
  FROM anc_visits
  WHERE district IN ('Gaya', 'Nalanda')
    AND year IN (2021, 2023)
),
changes AS (
  SELECT
    r2023.district,
    r2023.anc_percentage - r2021.anc_percentage AS percentage_point_increase
  FROM yearly_rates r2021
  JOIN yearly_rates r2023 ON r2021.district = r2023.district
  WHERE r2021.year = 2021 AND r2023.year = 2023
)
SELECT * FROM changes;
```
